svg.title: 富士山 手書き地図ガイド
svg.desc: Generated contour guides from aggregated and interpolated GSI elevation data. Add route and annotations by hand.
svg.metadata: Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI), elevation tiles (Fundamental Geospatial Data elevation model), https://maps.gsi.go.jp/development/ichiran.html. Edited and aggregated into 10×10-pixel cells by yuiseki. This is not an official GSI product.
svg.text: 富士山 手書き地図ガイド
富士山周辺 · 標高 440–3760 m · 薄線 100 m / 太線 500 m
138.6190–138.8232°E · 35.2930–35.4281°N · 印刷は 100% / Actual size。薄線は標高ガイド、紙面に手書きのルートを加えてください。
ルート・注記を自由に加えてください
2 km ground distance · scale bar 20 mm · print at 100%
Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI), elevation tiles (Fundamental Geospatial Data elevation model)
Edited and aggregated into 10×10-pixel cells by yuiseki. This is not an official GSI product.
DEM10B values are interpolated and aggregated; contours are approximate guides, not a survey or finished hand-drawn map.
